create_task_subclass: create a subclass of Task to define a new continuous control task for the Control Suite
initialize_task_with_seed: initialize a Task instance with a random seed or RandomState for reproducible episodes
get_action_spec: get the BoundedArraySpec for MuJoCo actuators by calling action_spec on a Task instance
set_visualize_reward: set the visualize_reward property on a Task to enable reward-based color highlighting
customize_before_step: override before_step in a Task subclass to customize how actions map to physics controls
